beats.style: Expo Out entrances, hard hold cuts, spring on the rotation snap.

beats.name: Product slam

beats.style: Expo Out scale-down with a short settle, ring scales out while its stroke thins.

beats.name: Available now
beats.description: On the bar downbeat (6 s) the wordmark lifts up and an orange pill button pops in below with 'Available now'. The comp holds on the final lockup.
beats.style: Expo In Out lift, Back Out pill pop, text fades in after the pill.
